name: Feature request
about: Have an idea for the project? Let us know what you have in mind.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

What
What is the feature you’re suggesting? Give us a clear description of what you’d like to add or change.

Why
Why is this feature important? Describe the problem it solves, who it helps, or why you think it would be useful.

Where
Where does this feature belong? If applicable, mention the relevant part of the project, design, documentation, or user experience.

How
How could this feature be implemented? If you have ideas about the technical approach, design, or behavior, share them here.

Screenshots / references
If applicable, add screenshots, mockups, examples, or links that help explain the idea.

Additional context
Anything else that might be useful for understanding or evaluating the feature.
